titulo: Rivian spinout Also apologizes for delays in shipping futuristic e-bikes
cuerpo: Rivian's futuristic e-bike is delayed, and customers are not happy. Last year, Rivian's micromobility spinoff Also unveiled a new, software-controlled electric bike called the TM-B that immediately set the e-bike world ablaze.
